long_description:
The 90s & 2000s Bollywood Throwback Party!

Old-school hits. Timeless memories. One epic dance floor.

Austin, we're hitting REWIND! ⏪🪩

For the December edition of Desi Vibe Tribe's monthly party series at Neon Grotto, we're taking a nostalgic trip to the golden era of Bollywood with BOLLY REWIND - a night dedicated to the music we grew up loving and the memories that never get old.

🎧 This month, we're especially excited to team up with DJ NISH! We can't wait to bring his throwback set to the DVT dance floor. Expect a nostalgic ride through Bollywood classics, iconic 90s anthems, and unforgettable 2000s bangers.

Joining him is DVT's very own DJ GABRU, keeping the energy high with Bollywood, Punjabi, and Desi dance-floor favorites.

WHAT'S ON THE MIXTAPE? 📼

🎶 90s & 2000s Bollywood Classics

🔥 Punjabi Bangers + Desi Dance Anthems

🎧 DJ NISH × DJ GABRU

💨 Hookah + 🍸 Cocktails

🪩 Retro Nostalgia + Nonstop Dancing

THE PARTY DETAILS

📅 Friday, December 4th

📍 Neon Grotto | Downtown Austin

🕤 Doors Open: 9:30 PM

🎵 Bolly • Punjabi • Desi Hits All Night

Same Tribe. New Theme. Timeless Music.

It's our monthly DVT ritual, but this time we're turning back the clock. Bring your crew, channel your inner Bollywood superstar, and get ready for a night that feels like your favorite old-school mixtape coming to life.

From SRK-era romance to full-on Bollywood dance madness, we're bringing the nostalgia, the sing-alongs, and the moves you thought you'd forgotten.

Dust off those dance moves. The rewind starts here. 📼🔥

🎟️ Grab your tickets and join the throwback! 

Also check out other Trips & Adventurous Activities in Austin.
